SELECT learner_profiles.user_id 
FROM learner_profiles JOIN users ON users.id = learner_profiles.user_id 
WHERE learner_profiles.user_id = %(user_id_1)s::UUID
SELECT public.poc_upload_read(CAST(%(owner)s AS uuid),CAST(%(exercise)s AS uuid),CAST(%(id)s AS uuid))

WITH expired AS (
    UPDATE public.poc_upload_operations SET status='cancelled'
    WHERE owner=CAST(%(owner)s AS uuid) AND id=CAST(%(old_active)s AS uuid)
      AND id<>CAST(%(id)s AS uuid) AND status='running'
), slot AS (
    UPDATE public.poc_account_slots SET fence=%(fence)s, active=CAST(%(id)s AS uuid)
    WHERE owner=CAST(%(owner)s AS uuid) AND fence=%(old_fence)s
      AND active IS NOT DISTINCT FROM CAST(%(old_active)s AS uuid)
    RETURNING owner
), operation AS (
    INSERT INTO public.poc_upload_operations(owner,id,exercise,upload_key,fingerprint,checkpoint,fence,status,expires)
    SELECT owner,CAST(%(id)s AS uuid),CAST(%(exercise)s AS uuid),%(key)s,%(hash)s,%(checkpoint)s,%(fence)s,'running',%(expires)s FROM slot
    ON CONFLICT(owner,id) DO UPDATE SET fence=EXCLUDED.fence,status=EXCLUDED.status,expires=EXCLUDED.expires
    RETURNING id
) SELECT count(*) FROM operation
SELECT public.poc_upload_read(CAST(%(owner)s AS uuid),CAST(%(exercise)s AS uuid),CAST(%(id)s AS uuid))

WITH attempt AS (
    INSERT INTO public.attempts(id,exercise_id,transcription,recognized_text,confidence,transcription_source,status,created_at)
    VALUES(CAST(%(id)s AS uuid),CAST(%(exercise)s AS uuid),CAST(%(transcription)s AS jsonb),%(recognized)s,%(confidence)s,%(source)s,'transcribed',%(now)s)
    RETURNING id
), checkpoint AS (
    UPDATE public.conversations SET data=CAST(%(document)s AS jsonb),state=%(state)s,
      pending_attempt_id=(SELECT id FROM attempt),updated_at=%(now)s
    WHERE exercise_id=CAST(%(exercise)s AS uuid) AND data=CAST(%(expected)s AS jsonb) AND NOT CAST(%(fail)s AS boolean)
    RETURNING exercise_id
), operation AS (
    UPDATE public.poc_upload_operations SET status='complete'
    WHERE owner=CAST(%(owner)s AS uuid) AND id=CAST(%(id)s AS uuid) AND fence=%(fence)s AND status='running'
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkpoint)
    RETURNING id
), slot AS (
    UPDATE public.poc_account_slots SET active=NULL
    WHERE owner=CAST(%(owner)s AS uuid) AND active=CAST(%(id)s AS uuid) AND fence=%(fence)s
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM operation)
    RETURNING owner
) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM attempt),(SELECT count(*) FROM checkpoint),
         (SELECT count(*) FROM operation),(SELECT count(*) FROM slot)
